answer: Infeasible: VLC media player does not have an automatic brightness and contrast adjustment feature that can detect or match room lighting conditions. All video adjustment controls in VLC (accessed via Tools > Effects and Filters > Video Effects) are manual sliders only. The Essential tab provides manual brightness, contrast, saturation, and gamma controls, but there is no automatic adaptation or room lighting detection capability available in VLC.
